description: Channels bridge/JidoChat slice stacked on #812. Normalize a typed history kind (direct vs channel) and verified provider/connector/channel/thread coordinates from configured bridge and adapter-sourced channel metadata, not arbitrary Incoming.metadata or webhook body claims. Keep author Person resolution on Engine IncomingMessageRouter; do not grant access here or change mention gating. Tests FIRST: DM versus room, unknown kind fail closed, forged metadata/config mismatch, cross-connector isolation and existing routing regression. Reuse CommunicationBridge.put_routing_context and Incoming.RoutingContext; do not create a new Action or agent tool. Docs Channels guide, test handbook; no feature E2E authored before human UX approval.

comments.text: 2026-09-26 Action reuse before edit: `CommunicationBridge.put_routing_context` is the existing channel->Engine stamping boundary; `Incoming.RoutingContext.normalize` owns typed serializable routing fields; `JidoChatBridge.to_internal` owns Jido.Chat adapter conversion. Extend these three rather than add Action, duplicate bridge or agent tool. Person/recipient ID lookup remains Engine IdentityResolver after ingress; new history_kind never grants access. Test-first showed missing field and forged context. Important discovered adapter limitation: `Jido.Chat.ChannelMeta.is_dm` defaults to false even when no actual room-type evidence. Fail closed: typed default without chat_type leaves history_kind nil; explicit adapter map false or typed known channel/group type yields :channel, true yields :direct. Claimed provider/room metadata must match configured provider/room; route overwrites incoming metadata/routing claims from configured bridge options. This limitation may require provider adapter enrichment before group history integration in .4. No E2E authoring.
